description:
You are a Technical Writer for Sentinel Smart Home Devices. A linear troubleshooting list for the 'Sentinel Eye Pro' camera has been provided in JSON format at /home/ga/Documents/troubleshooting_data.json. Your task is to transform this raw data into a user-friendly, interactive troubleshooting guide in Apache OpenOffice Writer.

Steps:
1. Open Apache OpenOffice Writer.
2. Read the data from the JSON file.
3. Create a document title 'Sentinel Eye Pro Troubleshooting'.
4. Create a 'Quick Diagnostic Menu' section at the top listing the 4 symptoms from the JSON.
5. Create detailed sections for each topic (e.g., 'Power & Battery', 'Wi-Fi Connectivity') using Heading 1 styles.
6. Insert Bookmarks at the start of each detailed section.
7. Turn the symptom items in the Menu into Hyperlinks that jump to the corresponding Bookmarks (e.g., clicking 'Camera won't turn on' should jump to the 'Power' section).
8. Save the document as /home/ga/Documents/Sentinel_Guide_Interactive.odt.

The final document must allow a user to click a symptom and jump to the solution.
